billReview.title: Bill photo capture
billReview.subtitle: Check what the bill says, match it with the order and the goods received, then make the bill
billReview.sources: From the phone or uploaded here
billReview.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.
billReview.uploadFailed: Could not upload the file. Nothing was saved.
billReview.readingNote: Reading the photo automatically (QR code and printed text) arrives once the AI provider is chosen. Until then, type what the bill shows; every check below is done by the server.
billReview.typeNote: Type the fields from the photo. The supplier is found from the GSTIN when you leave it blank.

aria.description: As written on the bill, line {{n}}

billReview.keyboard: Enter on the last rate adds a line.

err.amount: Amount in rupees, up to 2 decimals.
err.party: Choose the supplier or type their GSTIN.
err.line: Line {{n}}: give a quantity (up to 3 decimals) and a rate.

checks.title: Checks
checks.notYet: Save the fields, then match with the order and the goods received.
checks.dupOk: Bill number not entered before for this supplier.
checks.dupBad: This bill number is already entered for this supplier.
checks.noOrder: No purchase order: it posts as a direct purchase after Admin approves.
checks.rate: Line {{line}}: bill rate ₹{{bill}} against the order rate ₹{{order}}.
checks.taxBad: The tax on the bill differs from the HSN table, which gives taxable ₹{{taxable}}, CGST ₹{{cgst}}, SGST ₹{{sgst}}, IGST ₹{{igst}}.
checks.priceUp: Line {{line}}: ₹{{bill}} is dearer than the last rate ₹{{last}}.
checks.noTolerance: No tolerance is set in Settings, so quantity and rate must match exactly.

billReview.fieldsSaved: Fields saved. Now match with the order and the goods received.
billReview.confirmEffect: Posts bill {{no}} from {{supplier}} for ₹{{total}} to the books (input GST and the supplier's account).
billReview.noRight: You don't have the right to work on supplier bills. Ask Admin.
billReview.stepsNote: Type → match → bill draft → post. A bill that does not match can be drafted only by Admin.

list.title: All bill photos
list.emptyBody: Take a photo on the phone (Bill photo) or upload one here.
